explanation: The theorem states that the roots (as a multiset) of the polynomial `data.Φ.map (eval₂RingHom ...)` for the library-specific modular polynomial `ModularPolynomialData.Φ`, the `qExpand`/`qTwist`/`coeffEmb jq` expansions and the Laurent series ring, are `Nodup`. None of these objects (`ModularPolynomialData`, `qExpand`, `qTwist`, `coeffEmb`, `jq`) exist in Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core; grepping Mathlib for them yields only unrelated names like `Finset.coeEmb`/`Multiset.coeEmbedding`. The only related Mathlib results are the generic `Polynomial.nodup_roots` (needs `Separable p`), `Polynomial.nodup_roots_iff_of_splits` and `Polynomial.Splits`-based criteria in `Mathlib/FieldTheory/Separable.lean`, none of which can be applied to this specific Laurent-series polynomial without the library's own decomposition `roots_prime_at_slot` (that is exactly what the library proof uses, via its own `roots_prime_at_slot` and `roots_prime_at_slot_nodup`). Deriving separability/split-nodup for this polynomial from Mathlib alone would require substantial work, so no duplicate or special case was found.
